tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru: gu ru padma'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs byin brlab sprin phung dngos grub char rgyun myur stsol ni/ gter zhal phye dang shog ser phab: gzhan yang dus dang rnam pa kun: pad 'byung yid dang mi 'bral zhing : gsol ba rtse gcig 'di ltar btab: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: bar lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī:ya tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum sogs kyi mthar/ gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la: lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs: ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs: yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi bskur bar byin gyis rlobs: rgyud bzhi dag par byin gyis rlobs: lam bzhi 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma dhe wa dhā ki ni kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: stag rar 'gro don phyin pa'i skabs// bang rir gnas 'brel zhag bdun rjes// lo tog phan phyir char slong sar// stag rje chos skyong rgyal po yis// mos gus lha rdzas bcas bskul ngor// padma bde chen gling pa ngas// shog ser ngos nas dag par mos// yig ris u rgyan gling pas bgyis// gsol 'debs rgyal po 'dir 'bad na// gnas skabs mthar thug dge kun thob// gnas bzang bde chen zhing du skye// zhes kyang smras so/// /
